fullPassage: We are exceptionally smart, and this helps us adapt to a wide range of environments. But we are not nearly smart enough as individuals to solve the adaptive problems that confronted modern humans as they spread across the globe. The package of tools, foraging techniques, ecological knowledge, and social arrangements used by any group of foragers being far too complex for any individual to create. We are able to learn all the things we need to know in each of the many different environments in which we live only because we acquire information from others. We are much better at learning from others than other species are, and we are motivated to learn from others even when we do not understand why our models are doing what they are doing. This psychology allows human populations to accumulate pools of adaptive information that greatly exceed the inventive capacities of individuals.

questions.passage: We are exceptionally smart, and this helps us adapt to a wide range of environments. But we are not nearly smart enough as individuals to solve the adaptive problems that confronted modern humans as they spread across the globe. The package of tools, foraging techniques, ecological knowledge, and social arrangements used by any group of foragers being far too complex for any individual to create. We are able to learn all the things we need to know in each of the many different environments in which we live only because we acquire information from others. We are much better at learning from others than other species are, and we are motivated to learn from others even when we do not understand why our models are doing what they are doing. This psychology allows human populations to accumulate pools of adaptive information that greatly exceed the inventive capacities of individuals.

det.korean: 인간 개인은 한계가 있지만, 타인으로부터 배우는 능력 덕분에 적응 정보를 축적할 수 있다는 것이 핵심
det.analysis:
❌ ① 지능의 우월성만 다루지 않음 — 오히려 한계 강조
❌ ② 생태 지식 발전은 부분적 소재일 뿐
✅ ③ 타인으로부터 배우는 능력의 중요성
❌ ④ 채집 사회 구조는 예시일 뿐
det.tip: 핵심 키워드: acquire information from others, better at learning from others

ch: 인간의 창의력은 다른 종보다 뛰어나므로, 개인이 모든 문제를 해결할 수 있다.
채집 사회의 도구와 기술은 단순하여 누구나 쉽게 만들 수 있다.
인간은 모방 대상의 행동 이유를 완전히 이해한 후에만 학습할 수 있다.
개인의 지적 능력에는 한계가 있으므로, 타인으로부터의 학습이 인간 적응의 핵심이다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 개인의 한계 → 타인 학습 → 적응 정보 축적이 글의 핵심 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문은 개인의 한계를 강조
❌ ② far too complex = 단순하지 않음
❌ ③ even when we do not understand = 이해 없이도 학습
✅ ④ 개인 한계 + 타인 학습 = 적응의 핵심
det.tip: 요지 = 주제 + 필자의 주장/의견
